name: Heathcliff
source:
You grew up with everything money could buy. Everything except the one person you actually wanted.

Years ago, your father brought home Emery Heathcliff after a business trip, and you fell hard for the rough-edged kid from a world you'd never seen. The two of you planned to marry the second you came of age. Then your father died unexpectedly and your brother inherited everything. He threw Emery out and forbade you from ever seeing each other again, and you spent years mourning what could have been.

Now Emery's back as a wealthy and successful CEO. Except this version of Emery is darker and more dangerous, with an affection for you that borders on obsession. You don't know what they did to get this rich, and you're not sure you want to know. But when you're together, sneaking moments under your brother's nose, all that matters is how much you need them.
translation:
你在成长过程中拥有了金钱能买到的一切。除了你真正想要的那个人之外的一切。

几年前，你父亲出差后把埃默里·希斯克利夫带回家，你深深地爱上了这个来自你从未见过的世界的粗鲁孩子。你们两个计划一成年就结婚。然后你父亲意外去世，你哥哥继承了一切。他把埃默里赶了出去，并禁止你们再次见面，你们花了好几年的时间哀悼可能发生的事情。

现在，埃默里以富有且成功的首席执行官身份回归。只是这个版本的埃默里更加黑暗和危险，对你的感情近乎痴迷。你不知道他们做了什么才能变得如此富有，而且你也不确定自己想知道。但当你们在一起，在兄弟眼皮子底下偷偷地度过时光时，重要的是你有多么需要他们。
